alt: A hydroelectric dam: a pale concrete arch dam with buttresses and a gated walkway between two brown rock cliffs, calm blue reservoir water behind it, a concrete powerhouse with tall arched amber windows at its foot with a roof transformer on ceramic insulators and a still tailwater channel in front, on a square base plate

provenance.prompt: Isometric game building icon for a historical civilization strategy game: a hydroelectric dam, a massive pale concrete arch dam curving across a short stretch of the base plate between two solid brown rock cliff blocks, calm deep-blue reservoir water held on one side, a row of three dark gates along the top with a walkway and a plain concrete railing, a stepped dry spillway channel down the other side, and a squat concrete powerhouse at the foot with tall arched windows glowing amber and a flat roof with a solid transformer housing on ceramic insulators. One building on a small square base plate, three-quarter view from above and slightly right, centred and filling about 80% of a square image. Clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark ink outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette, readable at 40 pixels. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. No flag, no banner, no lattice pylons, no open framework, no power lines, no waterfall spray, no foam, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no readable screens, no smoke, no mist, no watermark. Square 1:1 image.
